campaigns.title: Start with one signal.
campaigns.audience: First-time visitors who need one clear member entry before exploring all thirteen.
campaigns.promise: Meet Saeyan through one identity thread, then choose how the signal continues.
campaigns.message: A smaller first choice makes the full Loom world easier to enter.
proof: Saeyan is M01 and Loom's first signal.
Her live Harne vote offers three public identity threads.
The destination keeps the full member archive one step away.

campaigns.title: The mark comes back.
campaigns.audience: Music and visual-direction viewers who want a complete track before opening production detail.
campaigns.promise: Enter through the Ink final master and continue into its visible track evidence.
campaigns.message: One finished screen should lead to the members, choices, and production logic behind it.
proof: The current site links the Ink final master and its visual master set.
Track pages preserve source-facing archive context instead of inventing performance claims.
The next action can be a track view, member discovery, or Harne signal.

campaigns.title: See the idea become proof.
campaigns.audience: Brand, fashion, beauty, and content teams evaluating Loom's planning-to-screen process.
campaigns.promise: Review selected spec-film cases through objective, viewer read, proof, and claim boundaries.
campaigns.message: A commercial case is useful when the screen logic and the limits of the claim are both visible.
proof: Cases expose objective, story, viewer read, and visible proof.
Spec work is labeled as spec work, not an official brand partnership.
The inquiry route stays separate from analytics event data.
